profile.summary: StoryCenter is a nonprofit that runs digital storytelling workshops. Participants learn to create short, personal media stories. The organization says its work promotes deep listening and community connection. It was formerly known as the Center for Digital Storytelling.

review.notes: ProPublica (EIN 94-2660844, Berkeley CA, 501(c)(3)) and storycenter.org (contact, about, history pages) confirm StoryCenter, a digital storytelling nonprofit formerly the Center for Digital Storytelling and based in Berkeley until a later move to Oakland, which fits a Linked Learning professional services contract. The phone, generic info@ email, address and neutral summary are all supported.
